caveats.value: Arena WebDev is a dated user-preference snapshot of front-end generation. AA Terminal-Bench measures terminal task completion using a controlled harness; the Coding Agent Index measures agent + model configurations. The scores are not interchangeable.

Third-party summaries attributed to MorphLLM should be checked against AA and tbench.ai. MorphLLM also offers inference services. This section uses primary AA and tbench results; it does not label reverified agent scores as third-party evidence.

Vendor-reported results remain separate. Z.ai’s GLM Flash vendor chart uses Terminal-Bench 2.1 and is excluded from this 4.0 comparison. Anthropic’s 4.0 result is shown alongside, with its different xhigh effort and fallback noted; the independent AA score drives sorting.

Arena’s displayed 3:1 ratio weights output tokens three times input tokens: (input + 3 × output) / 4. The other site scatter uses three input tokens per output token. Arena’s provider quotes can differ from official list prices; do not combine those cost measures.

The connected line is the efficient frontier among the selected current-snapshot models. It is not Arena’s global frontier. Kimi’s historical observation and missing model entries are excluded from the charts.

Current Intelligence Index data uses AA v4.3.2. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is directly verified on the current index; no number is inferred from open-weight status. Older index scores and older speed or token-use summaries are excluded.

name_checks.value: GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6.1 Sol are distinct AA models. The supplied predecessor terminal figure is not assigned to the GPT-6.1 baseline; each model and agent configuration keeps its own source.
GLM-5.3 and GLM 5.3 Flash are distinct models. The OpenCode and Claude Code flagship references do not establish Flash performance.
ClinePass lists DeepSeek V4 Flash, while this comparison uses V4.1 Flash. OpenCode Go lists Qwen3.8 Flash without confirming the Flash Next alias. Exact support remains Not found.
